declared_exclusions.item: the AUTHENTICATED end-to-end read of harvest_search_articles through mcp.opalinvest.dev
declared_exclusions.reason: The CVO's A3 condition pulls that one tool on a 502/504 or a call over 60 s against the ALB's idle timeout. The edge requires a bearer for /mcp and minting one is outside this order, so the duration was measured through the installed code on the in-region host: 16.87 s, a 43 s margin, and well under the 38-48 s this box's own link measured at Phase A. That is the number the condition turns on, but it is NOT a measurement of the ALB path itself and GT_SERVED.json says so rather than implying coverage.

declared_exclusions.item: the audit records the ten admitted reads would have written
declared_exclusions.reason: audit.log_call -> _emit -> put_object whenever AUDIT_S3_BUCKET is set, and this order's BOUNDS say no object is written to any bucket, so the harness replaced the sink with an in-process recorder. The admission, the tools and the gate ran as installed; the verdicts are measured as what the sink would have received, not as objects in the audit bucket.

A8's route (a) moved the served page to its LF form, so yr1.AC2 -- which compares the host against md5_source 0d828b51 in W/YR_SERVED.json -- will now read host-md5 != source against a correct deploy. Re-pointing that record to 3bbd5ab2 is the issuer's call, raised in the report and in Z-S135, and deliberately NOT done unilaterally inside this order.
